d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Kitchen professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
As a Commis II you are responsible for the daily food preparation and duties assigned to meet the set standard and qualities.
q: You should have a professional kitchen apprenticeship or chefs training course and previous experience in quality establishments along with good culinary skills. The ability to communicate in English and a proven track of food preparation, presentation and preservation knowledge is an essential.
The ideal candidate will be positively spirited and passionate about food and be committed to work together with the service team to deliver an amazing guest experiences every time.

You are a very positive, dynamic, creative and dedicated team player with the ability to work in a multicultural environment and under difficult condition while possessing the following additional competencies
r: li
Support the Demi Chef de Partie or Commis I in the daily operation and work
li
Work according to the menu specifications by the Chef de Partie
li
Keep work area at all times in hygienic conditions according to the rules set by the hotel
li
Control food stock and food cost in his section
li
Prepare the daily mis en place and food production in different sections of the main kitchen or satellites
li
Follow the instructions and recommendations from the immediate Superiors to complete the daily tasks
li
Ensure the highest standards and consistent quality in the daily preparation and keep up-to-date with the new products, recipes and preparation techniques
li
Coordinate and participate with other sections of requirements, cleanliness, wastage and cost control

d: Join a hotel that is a member of the Accor network, whose group brings together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations. Here, we believe in you and what you bring to the table. There are many opportunities for development and advancement. Every gesture, every smile, every action, contributes to creating a positive and memorable impact for our customers, our colleagues and also for our planet. Together, we embody the vision of responsible hospitality.
Take the opportunity to become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you in this world where life beats faster.
Develop and implement strategic marketing plans to enhance the hotel's brand positioning, visibility, and revenue growth.

Collaborate with Sales, Revenue, Food & Beverage, and other departments to drive business performance and revenue opportunities.
Strengthen and maintain the hotel's brand identity, ensuring consistency across all marketing channels.
Develop creative and innovative marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness, guest engagement, and market share.
Manage the hotel's digital presence, including website content, SEO, online advertising, and social media platforms.
Build and maintain strong relationships with media, influencers, agencies, and strategic business partners.
Plan and execute marketing initiatives for restaurants, bars, wellness facilities, events, and seasonal promotions.
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and trend assessments to identify new business opportunities.

Monitor marketing performance, campaign effectiveness, and key performance indicators to achieve business targets.

q: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
Minimum 7–10 years of progressive marketing experience, including at least 3–5 years in a senior marketing leadership role, preferably within luxury hospitality.
Proven experience in developing and executing successful integrated marketing strategies and brand campaigns.
Strong understanding of luxury hotel positioning, digital marketing, public relations, social media, and commercial performance.
Demonstrated ability to manage marketing budgets, evaluate campaign performance, and deliver measurable business results.
Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Creative, commercially driven, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
Strong knowledge of the UAE hospitality market, luxury travel trends, and competitive landscape is an advantage.

d: Capital Haus serves private clients and high net worth individuals in Dubai, combining investment expertise with a highly personal service.

We build bespoke portfolios across listed and unlisted markets, shaped around each client’s objectives and appetite for risk. Our approach brings together considered investment selection, access to specialist opportunities and an ongoing relationship with a team that understands their priorities.
We’re looking for a Senior Relationship Manager to build and grow client relationships from our Dubai office.

You’ll work with high net worth and institutional clients, taking responsibility for understanding their needs and bringing together the right expertise from across the business. You’ll also play an active part in developing new relationships through your network, referrals and introductions.
This role suits someone who enjoys winning new business and puts the same effort into looking after clients once they’re on board.
q: Experience managing client relationships in wealth management, private banking or investment advisory
A track record of developing new business and retaining client relationships
A sound understanding of investment products, portfolio construction and asset allocation
The ability to explain investment decisions clearly and handle difficult conversations with confidence
Experience working with investment specialists and compliance teams
Good judgement, attention to detail and ownership of your work
Ideally, experience in the UAE or wider GCC market
A relevant degree, with qualifications such as CFA or CFP welcomed
r: li
Manage and develop a portfolio of client relationships, maintaining regular contact as their priorities evolve
li
Understand clients’ financial objectives, investment experience, liquidity needs and appetite for risk
li
Work with investment and research colleagues to develop appropriate proposals and explain the thinking behind them
li
Keep clients informed about portfolio performance and developments relevant to their investments
li
Identify new opportunities through referrals, networking and prospective client conversations
li
Coordinate onboarding, maintain accurate records and work closely with compliance throughout the relationship
li
Contribute ideas that improve the service clients receive
